T6.source: reconstructed from public replays of the player dksnnfud (Incineroar version of the Kanto-starters sun + Trick Room team), 2026-09-20
T6.note: no open team sheet exists for this team; see provenance

provenance.Blastoise: item (Blastoisinite) and all four moves seen in his games; Quiet + Rain Dish from the 15 top-player Fake Out/Water Spout sheets (15/15 Quiet)
provenance.Farigiraf: item (Sitrus Berry) and all four moves seen in his games; Armor Tail 335/335 sheets; Bold = most common nature on Trick Room + Helping Hand sheets; bulk spread is a guess
provenance.Venusaur: item (Focus Sash) and all four moves seen in his games; Chlorophyll 85/85, Modest 73/85 sheets
provenance.Torkoal: Eruption, Heat Wave, Protect and Drought seen; Weather Ball = most common 4th move (37/83), Charcoal 81/83, Quiet 82/83 sheets
provenance.Charizard: never brought by him; Charizardite Y, Heat Wave, Solar Beam, Ancient Power, Protect all seen from four other players running this exact team; Modest 183/205 sheets
provenance.Incineroar: never reached the field in any of the 4 games of this version; most common top-player set (517/1038 sheets); Passho Berry = most common item once Sitrus Berry is taken by Farigiraf (item clause); bulk spread is a guess
provenance.spreads: EVs are never visible; Champions units (cap 32, budget 66), offence + Speed for the sun attackers, HP + offence for the Trick Room attackers, HP + defence for the two supports
